problem: The text says "two states: q0 start, q1 after seeing a 0, q2 after seeing 01" – that is contradictory. The DFA for (0|1)*01 needs three states, not two.
fix: State that the DFA has three states: q0 (start, no relevant suffix), q1 (last symbol seen is 0), q2 (last two symbols are 01 and is accepting).

problem: The given expression (0|1)*0(0|1)* ∪ (0|1)*1(0|1)* is wrong. It describes all non‑empty strings, not the set of strings that do not end with 01.
fix:
Replace with a correct expression, e.g.:
¬L = ε ∪ 0 ∪ 1 ∪ (0|1)*(00 ∪ 10 ∪ 11)
which captures all strings of length <2 and all strings of length ≥2 whose last two symbols are not 01.

problem: The statement "All four problems are decidable in time linear in the number of states of the automata" is inaccurate for equivalence (and finiteness) which require constructing a product automaton and can take O(n1·n2) time.
fix: Change to: "All four problems are decidable in time linear in the size of the input automata; equivalence and finiteness may require a product construction, giving O(n1·n2) time in the worst case."
